stem: Kabir checks a desk lamp that uses an incandescent bulb. The thin wire inside the glass bulb is broken. He also keeps an LED night lamp on the same shelf.

statements.text: The desk lamp cannot glow, because the broken filament stops the current.
The glass bulb, not the filament, produces the light, so an unbroken bulb is enough.
The LED night lamp cannot glow, because it has no filament.

teacher.key_rationale: A broken filament means the incandescent desk lamp cannot glow. The glass does not produce the light, and an LED can glow without a filament.
